<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def state(fr):
    pl=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            pl.append((n['color'],min(cs),max(cs)))
    nb=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            nb.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return pl, sorted(nb)

print("BEFORE:", state(current_frame))
r = action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
print("AFTER 1 LEFT:", state(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def state(fr):
    pl=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            pl.append((n['color'],min(cs),max(cs)))
    nb=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            nb.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return pl, sorted(nb)

print("BEFORE:", state(current_frame))
r = action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
print("AFTER 1 LEFT:", state(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
